rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts with median-of-ratios normalization, explicit chow reference level and named HFD-vs-chow contrast, apeglm shrinkage, and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering. QC is design-specific, retaining sample_01 by default, characterizing it via library size, blind-VST PCA (top 500) and a distance heatmap, and gating exclusion on a stated reason beyond depth. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified. Enrichment correctly uses the mouse-native Hallmark MH collection with a stated version, fgsea preranked on the full tested-gene list by Wald statistic, 15-500 size window, and refuses to substitute human sets without an ortholog map. The report covers method, versions, design formula, thresholds, gene counts, sample_01 disposition and caveats; minor deductions because the design formula is only stated in the report step rather than the DE step and one caveat phrase is slightly garbled.
